## What this assignment will cover

- Define the structure of a recursive solution: base case and recursive case.
- Correctly use the terms "winding phase" and "unwinding phase".
- Argue why a recursive solution is generally less efficient than an iterative one.
- Describe the role the runtime stack plays in recursive execution.
- Reason about the time complexity of the Towers of Hanoi problem.

## Course skills

Primary practice for skills **E1, E2, E3**. See
[Skills & Check-Ins](../checkins.html) for what each one means and when it is assessed.
